coverage.population: Selected autonomous-driving safety evidence within operational domains.
coverage.included: 10 selected, source-verified records; nonexhaustive unless explicitly stated in metric.
coverage.omitted: Unreported entities and unavailable measurements. No inference from absence.
coverage.missingness: Missing is unknown, never zero. Selected company cases are not a world census.

uncertainty: Current linked CSV values differ from some dashboard HTML point estimates; use this Oct2 corrected CSV consistently. 95% source Poisson intervals are preserved; estimates are observational, provider-reported and geographically weighted. 2022 human benchmark is not contemporaneous with all Waymo exposure; 32% injury underreporting correction is source applied. Cannot generalize to other systems, all roads or snow; source notes residual time-of-day confounding.
limitations: Current linked CSV values differ from some dashboard HTML point estimates; use this Oct2 corrected CSV consistently.
95% source Poisson intervals are preserved; estimates are observational, provider-reported and geographically weighted.
2022 human benchmark is not contemporaneous with all Waymo exposure; 32% injury underreporting correction is source applied.
Cannot generalize to other systems, all roads or snow; source notes residual time-of-day confounding.

transform.description: Filter downloaded CSV3 by exact outcome, benchmark and grouping; retain five nonoverlapping service-area aggregates, all point estimates and intervals. No aggregate plus county double counting.
transform.validation: 1804 raw CSV rows; 11 matching selected rows; five nonoverlapping areas yield ten cohort rows. Asserted intervals bracket estimates.

verification.method: Primary pages opened and numeric/categorical records manually reconciled at stated locators.

forecast.reason: No new prediction is computed; dated plans, when present, are categorical disclosures, not observed completion.

proposedQuestion: How do reported injury crash rates compare within one provider’s operating domains?
